newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks up led by banks, cement.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks up led by banks, cement.

text.p: Colombian stocks edged up amid average volumes, led by banks and cement manufacturer Cementos del Caribe.
Bogota's IBB index closed up 0.68 percent at 1,231.55 on volume of 2.44 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index gained 0.69 percent to close at 18,736.77 on 2.8 billion pesos.
One of the day's biggest gainers was Cementos Caribe, part of the Sindicato Antioqueno industrial conglomerate, up 2.5 percent to 6,798 in Bogota and up 0.43 percent to 7,131 in Medellin.

Savings bank and building society Ahorramas, the smallest of its kind in Colombia, was up 2.04 percent to 500 in the wake of the announcement by financier Luis Carlos Sarmiento that he was looking to buy a stake in the bank. percent to 338.
Banco de Bogota, the country's third largest bank in terms of assets, closed up 0.56 percent at 7,140 in Bogota and ended up 0.43 percent at 7,131 in Medellin.
